_comment: Rotating tips shown on the free-tier wall. Edit the eyebrow (the small uppercase label) and the quotes list for each state. The page loads this file at runtime; if it can't be fetched, the built-in defaults in index.html are used instead. Use straight quotes and keep each quote on one line.

quotes: Reread the posting and note the words it keeps repeating — those repeats are usually what the role is really weighed on.
The strongest CVs echo the job's own language, not a thesaurus of it. A good moment to read yours back line by line.
Most postings put what matters most in the first third. Worth a slow second read before you spend your next run.
A gap is only worth fixing if the role actually asks for it — reread with that lens, and let the rest go.
Line up the two or three roles you want to run first, so tomorrow's runs go where they count.
Rewrite one bullet per role to mirror the posting's own words.
Pick your top gap from the last run and draft the fix now — tomorrow you'll just paste and go.
Compare two postings side by side: the overlapping asks are the skills to lead with.
